=== Day 2: the town meeting ===
Lian: "Merrin belongs at the top of our list. I saw them out in the street from my window last night."  [case board: #50, #51]
Merrin: "Beware Lian, good neighbors, before it's too late! Bartholomew's reading says the people living on the Docks aren't all on one side, and they live there."
Merrin: "From my window, I saw Nisha out in the street last night."  [case board: #52, #53]
Lian: "Here's what the town needs to know to narrow the list: I am the Psychologist."
Lian: "Last night, I learned that at least one of these two statements from day 1 was a lie or misreading: Merrin's Rumormonger reading (the night before you arrived); or Fenwick's Dowser reading (night 1)."  [case board: #54, #55, #24, #28]
Nisha: "It isn't a locked deduction yet, still—my read on Greta isn't clean."  [case board: #56]
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Gravedigger."
Greta: "Merrin is right on the money about Lian."  [case board: #57, #58]
Odette: "Are we doing public confessions tonight? Let's get mine over with: I am the Night Watch."
Odette: "The night before you arrived, I watched the Docks: nobody stirred."
Odette: "Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Constance out."  [case board: #59, #60, #61]
Agnes: "I'll not keep secrets from my neighbors when we're in such need. I am the Medium."  [case board: #62]
